app.title: Harz Routenplaner
panel.intro: Plan your hike in the Harz: set waypoints, compare routes and download them as GPX for Komoot. Free, no login, no tracking.
map.label: Map of the Harz
waypoints.title: Waypoints
waypoints.empty: Click the map or a stamp point to set waypoints. Drag the markers to move them.
waypoints.minHint: A route needs at least {min} waypoints.
error.outsideArea: This point is outside the planning area (Harz and surroundings up to approx. 40 km).
error.tooMany: More than {max} waypoints are not possible.
stamps.title: Stamp points
stamps.unavailable: The stamp points could not be loaded.
routes.title: Routes
routes.found: {count} routes found. The first one is selected.
routes.signage: Please follow the signs on site – paths may be closed, e.g. in the national park.
error.routingUnavailable: Route calculation is not available right now. Please try again later.
error.noRoute: No route was found for these waypoints. Are all points on or near paths?
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait {seconds} seconds.
error.invalidRequest: The request was invalid. Please reload the page.
speed.label: Speed in km/h
details.title: Details
details.timeHint: DIN 33466: distance ÷ speed, and 300 metres of ascent or 500 metres of descent per hour; the larger of the two times plus half of the smaller. Without breaks.
chart.label: Elevation profile of the selected route: {distance}, between {min} and {max} altitude.
details.stampsNone: No stamp point closer than 100 m to the route.
